limits: Facts-v1 rules: an occurrence counts as extracted only when its value, period, unit and dimensions are represented exactly; failures are listed, never dropped.
Core-concept anchors are a sanity check for the report period, not accounting validation; a company may legitimately use another concept.
Labels come only from the archived extension schema. Older filings keep labels in a separate label linkbase that the four-file archive does not include.
Without --discovery, missing filings cannot be detected; totals cover supplied archives only.
method: Original SEC files (filing index JSON, extracted XBRL instance, extension schema, primary inline HTML) read on 2026-11-01 in the Claude desktop browser from www.sec.gov, and checked with a JavaScript port of facts-v1 extract_facts() and check_inline_correspondence() at commit 724623f. On the bundled Microsoft sample the port reproduces the Python results exactly. Inventory: docs/validation/report-sections-2021-2026.json. Rerun `python -m sec_pipeline.fact_coverage` on the acquisition archive for the authoritative result.
